01

“And among the people is he who buys idle talk”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 31:6).

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
And among the people is he who buys idle talk [Luqman 6] he said: "It is buying male and female singers for a great deal of money, and listening to them and to the like of that falsehood."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يَشْتَرِي لَهْوَ الْحَدِيثِ [لقمان: 6] قَالَ: «هُوَ اشْتِرَاءُ الْمُغَنِّي وَالْمُغَنِّيَةَ بِالْمَالِ الْكَثِيرِ، وَالِاسْتِمَاعُ إِلَيْهِمْ، وَإِلَى مِثْلِهِ مِنَ الْبَاطِلِ»
Edition record 373060 · p. 541Link to report ↗
02
Explanation from Mujāhid 02

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
and takes it in mockery [Luqman 6] he said: "and takes the way of God in mockery."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَيَتَّخِذُهَا هُزُوًا [لقمان: 6] قَالَ: «وَيَتَّخِذُ سَبِيلَ اللَّهِ هُزُوًا»
Edition record 373061 · p. 541Link to report ↗

03

“And We had certainly given Luqman wisdom”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 31:12).

04
Explanation from Mujāhid 04

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
And We had certainly given Luqman wisdom [Luqman 12] meaning: "understanding, intellect, and soundness in speech, without prophethood."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا لُقْمَانَ الْحِكْمَةَ [لقمان: 12] ، يَعْنِي: «الْفِقْهَ وَالْعَقْلَ وَالْإِصَابَةَ فِي الْقَوْلِ فِي غَيْرِ نُبُوَّةٍ»

05

“Indeed, if it should be the weight of a mustard seed and should be…”

An explanation transmitted from Abū al-ʿĀliya.

06
Explanation from Abū al-ʿĀliya 06

Abū al-ʿĀliya

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Abu Jafar al-Razi related to us, from al-Rabi ibn Anas, from Abu al-Aliya, on His words:
Indeed, if it should be the weight of a mustard seed and should be within a rock or [anywhere] in the heavens or earth, God will bring it forth. Indeed, God is Subtle and Aware [Luqman 16], he said: "Subtle in bringing it out, Aware in producing it."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، ثنا أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ الرَّازِيُّ، عَنِ الرَّبِيعِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَالِيَةِ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
إِنْ تَكُ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِنْ خَرْدَلٍ فَتَكُنْ فِي صَخْرَةٍ أَوْ فِي السَّمَوَاتِ أَوْ فِي الْأَرْضِ يَأْتِ بِهَا اللَّهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَطِيفٌ خَبِيرٌ قَالَ: «لَطِيفٌ بِاسْتِخْرَاجِهَا خَبِيرٌ بِإِتْيَانِهَا»
Edition record 373065 · p. 542Link to report ↗
06

“and enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong”

An explanation transmitted from Abū al-ʿĀliya (Q 31:17).

07
Explanation from Abū al-ʿĀliya 07

Abū al-ʿĀliya

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Abu Jafar related to us, from al-Rabi, from Abu al-Aliya, on His words:
and enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong [Luqman 17] he said: "Whoever calls to faith and forbids the worship of idols has enjoined what is right and forbidden what is wrong."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، ثنا آدَمُ، ثنا أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ، عَنِ الرَّبِيعِ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَالِيَةِ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَأْمُرْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَانْهَ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ [لقمان: 17] قَالَ: «مَنْ دَعَا إِلَى الْإِيمَانِ، وَنَهَى عَنْ عِبَادَةِ الْأَوْثَانِ فَقَدْ أَمَرَ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ، وَنَهَى عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ»
Edition record 373066 · p. 542Link to report ↗

“and do not turn your cheek [in contempt] toward people”

Explanation from Mujāhid 08

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
and do not turn your cheek [in contempt] toward people [Luqman 18] he said: "It is turning away and averting the face from people."

وَلَا تُصَعِّرْ خَدَّكَ لِلنَّاسِ [لقمان: 18] قَالَ: «هُوَ الصُّدُودُ وَالْإِعْرَاضُ بِالْوَجْهِ عَنِ النَّاسِ»

08

“Your creation and your resurrection are not but as a single soul”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 31:28).

11
Explanation from Mujāhid 11

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
Your creation and your resurrection are not but as a single soul [Luqman 28] he said: "He says: little and much are equal to Him; He only says to it 'Be,' and it is."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
مَا خَلْقُكُمْ وَلَا بَعْثُكُمْ إِلَّا كَنَفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ [لقمان: 28] قَالَ: " يَقُولُ: الْقَلِيلُ وَالْكَثِيرُ عَلَيْهِ سَوَاءٌ، إِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُ: كُنْ فَيَكُونُ "
Edition record 373070 · p. 543Link to report ↗
12
Report from Mujāhid 12

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, and Adam related to us, saying: Shayban related to us, from Jabir, from Mujahid, who said:
"The khattar is the treacherous."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، وَنا آدَمُ، نا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
" الْخَتَّارُ: الْغَدَّارُ "

Explanation from Mujāhid 13

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English

الإسناد

10

“Indeed, God [alone] has knowledge of the Hour”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr and Saʿīd ibn al-Musayyab (Q 31:34).

14
Explanation from Mujāhid 14

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
Indeed, God [alone] has knowledge of the Hour [Luqman 34] he said: "A man from the desert people came to the Messenger of God ﷺ and said: 'My wife is pregnant, so tell me what she will bear. Our land is parched and barren, so tell me when the rain will fall. I know where I was born, so tell me where I will die.'" So God revealed this verse. Mujahid said: "They are the keys of the unseen; none knows them but He."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
إِنَّ اللَّهَ عِنْدَهُ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ [لقمان: 34] قَالَ: " جَاءَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْبَادِيَةِ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ، فَقَالَ: إِنَّ امْرَأَتِي حُبْلَى فَأَخْبِرْنِي مَاذَا تَلِدُ؟ وَبَلَدُنَا جَدْبَةٌ مَحْلٌ، فَأَخْبِرْنِي مَتَى يَنْزِلُ الْغَيْثُ، وَقَدْ عَلِمْتُ أَيْنَ وُلِدْتُ، فَأَخْبِرْنِي أَيْنَ أَمُوتُ ". فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ هَذِهِ الْآيَةَ قَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: «وَهُنَّ مَفَاتِيحُ الْغَيْبِ لَا يَعْلَمُهَا إِلَّا هُوَ»
Edition record 373073 · p. 543Link to report ↗
15
Report from Saʿīd ibn al-Musayyab 15

Saʿīd ibn al-Musayyab

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Sulayman ibn Harb related to us, from Hammad ibn Salama, from Ali ibn Zayd ibn Judan, from Said ibn al-Musayyab, who said:
"Luqman the Wise was a tailor."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ جُدْعَانَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ، قَالَ:
«كَانَ لُقْمَانُ الْحَكِيمُ خَيَّاطًا»
Edition record 373074 · p. 543Link to report ↗
